\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Each series is recorded at the end of its 30-minute interval (ET) and merged on that interval-end time stamp; the SPXW quotes are time-stamped in UTC and loaded separately. First and Last: the first and last interval with an observation; Obs.: the number of such intervals before the intraday grid is formed (constituents: per weighting; FOMC: announcements; SPXW: quotes). The VIX indices, the volatility-demand series and the FOMC calendar end before the futures sample (\mbox{2024-04-30}); after their last observation the availability indicator $a_{t,i}$ is zero and the value is imputed (Sections~\ref{sec:rh_data} and~\ref{sec:rh_predictors}). The data files also contain 6 other release indicators, an SPXW-implied variance and other VIX series, none of them used as a predictor. \textit{[vendor]}: the vendor is not yet named in any data file or document (the option chain is attributed to OptionMetrics only in a code comment).
\end{tablenotes}
